free_tier.stated: no self-serve free tier found; UltraDNS is an enterprise managed authoritative DNS platform sold through a sales contact, with flexible plans based on domains, queries, users and advanced features
free_tier.notes: unverified: the former Neustar DNS pages at home.neustar answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-19; the Neustar Security Services DNS line is now sold as Vercara / DigiCert UltraDNS, with no public free allowance. A historical free recursive DNS product is reported discontinued by a third party, not confirmed by a first-party page.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-record or per-zone object cap published on the first-party pages read; the platform is quoted on request

retention.stated: unverified: no retention or expiry period published on the first-party pages read; zones are managed under an enterprise agreement

egress.terms: a managed authoritative DNS service; the platform is stated to handle up to 150 billion authoritative DNS queries per day, but no free query allowance or per-query price is published

interface_detail: a REST API and portal for DNS records; an UltraDNS Terraform provider automates DNS changes. API credentials are configured through the vendor console.
tooling: the UltraDNS Terraform provider, the UltraDNS API, a vendor portal; CertCentral integrates with UltraDNS for DNS domain control validation
chaining: an enterprise authoritative DNS platform with traffic steering, failover, DNSSEC and an independent secondary Anycast network (UltraDNS 2); no self-serve free tier exists, so a free hosted DNS service is the path for a no-cost stack

limits.value: access is through a sales contact and an enterprise agreement; no public self-serve sign-up or free allowance is offered
the platform is stated to manage up to 150 billion authoritative DNS queries per day at scale; this is a capacity figure, not an allowance for a single account

binding_note: the DNS offer is an enterprise sales-quoted platform with no self-serve free tier, so the sales and contract gate binds before any query capacity or quota is relevant

identity_cost.detail: the sales-led motion is aimed at organizations: the page says Talk to an expert and describes plans for organizations that require reliable, scalable and secure DNS infrastructure. No self-serve signup page was found, and the exact registration fields, card requirement and phone requirement are unverified: behind a sign-up and a sales contact.

reliability_note: a 100 percent resolution availability SLA, 24/7 support and built-in DDoS protection are stated; no suspension, throttle or data-loss event was found on the pages read
confidence_note: the first-party DigiCert DNS page and the Neustar landing page were captured and quoted. The former home.neustar DNS URLs and the Vercara product and news URLs answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-19, so the old Neustar DNS pages themselves could not be read; the current offer is documented through the successor DigiCert page. No public read path was probed, so the rung stays documented.
